passage:
In Room 709, there is a green homework box beside the teacher's desk. Students put their homework there every morning.
One Monday, the box was missing. Students were confused. Some held their papers in their hands. Others placed them on the teacher's desk.
The teacher came in and said she had hidden the box for one day. She wanted students to think about systems. "When a system disappears," she said, "people need to understand the purpose, not only the habit."
The class discussed why the box was useful. It saved time, kept papers together, and made responsibility clear.
The next day, the box returned. Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.
